evals.name: standard-coding-day-retro
evals.prompt: alright let's wrap up the day. ran morning-routine this morning so the daily note should be at /home/jared/Documents/wiki/Inbox/2026-05-14.md. coding day on the schedule. got the auth migration PR opened and reviewer tagged (that was major 1). major 2 was 'address review comments on the metrics dashboard' — I got partway through, 3 of 5 comments addressed. major 3 was 'write the architecture-pivot doc section on phase 1c' and I skipped it because the dashboard work ate the afternoon. minors went 3/3. energy was a 7, dipped around 2pm before walk. mood: solid but slightly fragmented in the afternoon.
evals.expected_output: Walks through majors with criteria-met grading, syncs cranium-rework-migration project (since major 1 was that project's next action), runs short journalling interview, writes retro snapshot to Wiki/Personal/retros/2026-05-14.md, updates daily note end-of-day section, optionally proposes a 'cap minor sweeps on afternoon when major is review-heavy' adjustment.

evals.name: no-daily-note-journal-only
evals.prompt: today got away from me — no morning routine, no plan. but I want to log it. let's do retro anyway.
evals.expected_output: Detects missing daily note, offers journal-only mode, skips Phase 2 plan-grading, runs Phase 4 interview, writes retro snapshot with majors_completed=n/a and criteria_met_rate=n/a, does not attempt to grade nonexistent plan, does not propose adjustments (one-off day).

evals.name: project-completion-during-retro
evals.prompt: evening retro. filming day. wrapped major 1 which was 'shoot hook 3 + b-roll for change series video 1' — that was the last shot needed. video 1 is fully shot now, just needs the edit which is a separate project. let's close it out.
evals.expected_output: Grades the major, routes through project-tracker to mark ig-change-series-v1 status=completed (or proposes to), moves project to archive/, prompts user about lifting any learnings into a kind:insight page, updates index.md, writes retro snapshot reflecting the completion.

evals.name: trend-pattern-surface
evals.prompt: evening retro. wrap it up — 1/3 majors, 1/3 minors. third filming day this week where I skipped the planning major. energy was a 4, just gassed.
evals.expected_output: Grades the day, runs short interview (detect tired user — keep questions to 2), reads recent retros and surfaces the pattern 'planning major has been skipped on filming days 3/3 times this week', proposes adjustment (either drop the planning major from filming days OR move planning to a different block), asks whether to log it to planning-adjustments.md, writes snapshot. Does NOT moralise about completion rate.
